text: XTB S.A. is a Polish issuer listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange; per its shareholder-structure page (current report 22/2026 of 7 September 2026), XX ZW Investment Group S.A. holds 32,661,789 shares, 27.78% of capital and votes, with the remaining 72.22% in free float.
short: XTB S.A. trades on the Warsaw Stock Exchange; XX ZW Investment Group S.A. holds 27.78%, the rest is free float.

source.name: XTB Investor Relations - Akcjonariat (shareholder structure, per current report no. 22/2026 of 7 September 2026)
source.note: Page footnote: XX ZW Investment Group S.A., seated in Luxembourg, is directly controlled by Jakub Zabłocki, who holds shares representing 81.97% of its capital and votes. Table row for 'Other shareholders (free float)' shows 84,907,462 shares, 72.22%.
